summary: Completed comprehensive testing of Prime Potions ERP P0 and P1 features. All 26 backend tests passed. Frontend UI tests passed for Inventory Overview, Excel Sync, and Formulas pages.
critical_code_review_comments: All P0 and P1 features implemented correctly
Inventory on-hand endpoint properly aggregates from stock_snapshots
Search endpoints support searchable dropdowns with proper filtering
UOM endpoint returns expanded units including oz/fl oz
Excel export endpoints generate proper Prime Potions format files
Formulas support recipe_required toggle with variance_tolerance_percent
seed_data_creation: Test formulas created via API tests (TEST_Flexible_Formula, TEST_Strict_Formula, etc.)
context_for_next_testing_agent: All P0 and P1 features tested and working. Key pages: /inventory/overview (Inventory On-Hand), /excel-sync (Excel Export/Import), /formulas (Formulas with recipe_required toggle). Backend tests in /app/backend/tests/test_p0_p1_features.py cover all new endpoints.

P0_inventory_onhand.details: Returns items with on_hand_qty, available_qty, reserved_qty, stock_status. Supports search, type, category, below_min_only filters.

P0_low_stock_alerts.details: Returns items below min_stock_level with shortage calculation

P0_searchable_dropdowns.details: All search endpoints working with query and filter parameters

P0_expanded_uom.details: Returns expanded UOM list including KG, G, L, ML, OZ, FL_OZ, LB, EA, PCS, CASE, BOX

P1_excel_raw_materials.details: Exports Excel with RAW-MASTER INV sheet and exact Prime Potions headers

P1_excel_packaging.details: Exports Excel with Master inventory-Packaging sheet

P1_excel_batching.details: Exports Excel with Batching Sheet format (header row 4)

P1_formulas_recipe_required.details: Formulas support recipe_required toggle and variance_tolerance_percent. UI shows Flexible/Strict badges.

frontend_inventory_overview.details: Page loads with search input, type filter, below min checkbox, refresh button, and inventory table

frontend_excel_sync.details: Page loads with Export buttons for Raw Materials, Packaging, Batching Template. Import section shows Admin-only restriction.

frontend_formulas.details: Page loads with formula list showing Flexible/Strict badges. Add Formula dialog has Recipe Required toggle with Variance Tolerance field.
